notesStmt.note: Whitman probably created this manuscript shortly before the date inscribed at the top, "May 25" [1888]. Its first known publication was in November Boughs, later that year. Both the manuscript inscription and the note that appeared at the bottom of the published poem ("Publish'd May 30, 1888") suggest a prior newspaper publication (perhaps in the New York Herald, with which he had a contract to supply several pieces each month), no such appearance has been discovered.

note.p: This is a manuscript draft of "While Not the Past Forgetting," which was published in November Boughs (1888) and in later printings of Leaves of Grass as one of the "Sands at Seventies" poems.
